title: The Red Door Fits

beats.text: Elias noted the cabin near the northern ridge at dawn, its red door peeling like a deep sunburn against the grey mist.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome dark forest with a small cabin, red door stands out, heavy fog

beats.text: By noon, he found the same structure three miles south, identical down to the jagged crack in the upper window, and he whispered, 'It fits just right.'
beats.image_prompt: monochrome forest clearing with the same cabin, low angle, eerie lighting

beats.text: The map insisted this was impossible, yet when he reached the valley floor, the red door was waiting there again, humming with a soft, copper heat.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a weathered red wooden door in a forest

beats.text: He stepped inside to find no floor, only his own silhouette carved into the frame, and as the wood pressed against his spine, he knew it fit just right.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome interior of a cabin looking out into a forest, man's silhouette merged with door frame

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
